title: finance.market_summary
description: Get cached quotes for every tracked symbol, each enriched with its catalog display name + sector. The response is a snapshot of whatever is currently in the node's in-memory cache; the poller refreshes the cache on its own 5-minute cadence and this surface does not trigger fetches. Pass an optional `sector` to return only quotes in that sector group (case-insensitive exact match against the catalog tag).

sector.description: Optional sector filter, e.g. 'Semiconductors' or 'Defense'. Case-insensitive exact match against the catalog sector tag. Omit for the full tracked set.
